note: Who wins when a style hint and a purpose constraint name the same field (layers.resolve -> spec.hints). purpose: a technical constraint of the asset type; the purpose's constraints.<field> replaces the style's <field> and resolve marks the style hint overridden, so the prompt writer sees one value. style: taste only the style sets; a purpose may not constrain it (lint FAIL). Param precedence (size, background, quality) is separate: purpose params always beat style params.
